players.bio: Bobby Brian Faulkner is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Tranmere Rovers, on loan from EFL League One club Doncaster Rovers.
Charlie Veevers is a 21-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder or winger for Tranmere Rovers F.C. in EFL League Two.

Charlie Jay Whitaker (born 16 September 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League Two side Tranmere Rovers. Career Early career and Notts County A product of the Everton academy having joined from Blackburn Rovers at the age of 12 years-old, he signed a three-year contract at the club in 2022.

Coniah Boyce-Clarke (born 1 March 2003) is a professional football goalkeeper who plays for English League Two club Tranmere Rovers F.C. and represents the Jamaica national football team internationally. Club career Reading On 28 May 2019, Boyce-Clarke agreed to sign a professional contract with Reading, until the summer of 2023, to commence the summer after his 17th birthday.
Connor Joseph Jennings (born 29 October 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for League Two side Tranmere Rovers.
Courtney Romello Baker-Richardson (born 5 December 1995) is an English footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers.

Darrell James Clarke (born 16 December 1977) is an English professional football manager and former player who is the manager of EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers. A box-to-box midfielder, Clarke began his career with Mansfield Town in 1995, where he spent the first six years of his career, making 173 league and cup appearances.

David Joy Gbashai Kamara (born 4 January 2006) is an English-born professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward or striker for Tranmere Rovers F.C. on loan from League One parent club Peterborough United F.C..
Dylan Jones a English professional football forward. He plays for Tranmere Rovers in League Two, where he is currently on a season-long loan from Championship side Norwich City.
George Patrick Nevett is a Welsh professional footballer who plays for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers on loan from EFL League One club Peterborough United, as a defender.

Harrison Darren Male (born 13 September 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers. Male started his career at Leeds United after progressing through their academy. He spent time on loan at Tadcaster Albion before signing for Gateshead in 2020.
Jacob Vaughan Slater (born 5 October 2004) is an Irish footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers.

James John Plant (born 3 November 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers. Plant made his first-team debut at Port Vale in August 2022 and turned professional at the club in April 2023. He went on to have loan spells at Nantwich Town, Salisbury and Yeovil Town. He made a permanent transfer to Tranmere Rovers in January 2026.

Joe Samuel Ironside is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers. Born in Middlesbrough, he has also spent time on loan at Hartlepool United, Halifax Town and Harrogate Town and is the son of former Middlesbrough goalkeeper Ian Ironside.
Joel Toby Senior (born 24 June 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers.

Jordan Davies is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers. Born in Wrexham, Davies joined the local team's academy. He joined Cymru Premier side Bangor on a short-term loan the day after his 18th birthday. Following a spell with the youth academy of Brighton, he re-signed for Wrexham in 2020.

Jordan Robert Turnbull (born 30 October 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central defender for League Two club Tranmere Rovers. Turnbull began his career with the academy of Southampton, signing his first professional contract in 2013 and spending two seasons on loan at Swindon Town.

Lee Patrick O'Connor (born 28 July 2000) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers, and the Republic of Ireland national team. He has also spent time on loan at Partick Thistle.
Lewis Wesley Warrington (born 10 October 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers.

Luke Paul McGee (born 2 September 1995) is an English professional goalkeeper who plays for Tranmere Rovers. He trained regularly with - and acted as back-up to Tottenham senior stoppers Hugo Lloris and Michel Vorm throughout the 2015-16 season.

Nathan James Smith (born 3 April 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers. He turned professional at Port Vale in June 2014, and spent the 2014–15 season on loan at Stafford Rangers and the 2015–16 season on loan at Torquay United, winning the Player of the season award at Torquay.

Olly Scott is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back and midfielder for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers. Born on 22 October 2000, the 26-year-old versatile defender is the son of former Sunderland left-back Martin Scott.
Patrick John Brough (born 20 February 1996) is an English footballer who plays as a defender for Tranmere Rovers.

Ryan James Watson (born 7 July 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Tranmere Rovers. Watson was in the academy at Everton. Before leaving the club to join Wigan Athletic on a free transfer. He turned professional in 2011, and played for the Wigan Athletic Development Squad in the 2011–12 season.
Samuel Joseph Finley (born 4 August 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers.

Tom George Sawyer Conlon (born 3 February 1996) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for, and captains, EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers . He is a descendant of Football League players George Heppell and Albert Pearson. Conlon began his career in the youth set-up at Stoke City, later joining the youth academies at Newcastle Town and Peterborough United respectively.

Tom Ince is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder, right winger, or right midfielder for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers. The son of former England captain Paul Ince, Tom Ince began his career with Liverpool, for whom he made his professional début in the 2010–11 season, coming on as a substitute in the Football League Cup.

William Robert Vaulks (born 13 September 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers. He began his professional career at Tranmere Rovers in 2012 but did not make a senior appearance, going on loan to Workington of the Conference North before joining Scottish club Falkirk in February 2013.
Zane Okoro is an American professional football player who plays as a forward or right winger for EFL League Two club Tranmere Rovers, on loan from EFL Championship club Lincoln City
